claim_boundary: held-out frozen-probe measurement only; no causal, routing, utility, learning, or adaptation claim
checkpoint: post-transition final delay frame; before resolution
analysis_scope: per-model-seed and delay; complete public episodes remain within one split
sampling: fresh generative public evidence; resolved public histories are unique; evaluator target is never passed to Demian
falsifier: full-state held-out log-odds score does not exceed current-observation and shuffled-label controls consistently across model seeds
